project_name: PropConsult CRM - Premium Property Consultant Application

visual_theme.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / CRED-INSPIRED FINTECH LUXURY
visual_theme.primary_palette: Premium White (#FFFFFF), Deep Navy Blue (#0B192C / #0F172A), Slate Grey (#64748B / #F8FAFC)
visual_theme.accent_palette: Emerald Green (#10B981 for Shared Tick / Win), Gold / Amber (#F59E0B for Pipeline / High Value), Indigo (#6366F1 for Actions)
visual_theme.vibe: Clean CRED-like visual quality, Minimal, Elegant, Spacious, Fast, Trustworthy, Modern Indian Real Estate SaaS

typography.headline_h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white
typography.headline_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
typography.headline_h3: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold tracking-normal text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200
typography.label_overline: text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400
rules: DO NOT use Inter for main headings — use Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans.
Headings over 24px MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tight).
All overline labels MUST be uppercase with wider letter spacing (tracking-wider).
No pure #000000 or pure black background; tint greys with rich cool blue/slate.
Never use full transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or dropdown menus.
Primary brand color must be used intentionally for main CTAs and highlights only.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12). Use generous internal card padding (p-5 or p-6) to avoid edge collision.

responsive_breakpoints.mobile: grid-cols-1, bottom navigation bar fixed at bottom (z-40), swipeable cards/tables
responsive_breakpoints.tablet: grid-cols-2 or sidebar layout, collapsible details
responsive_breakpoints.desktop: sidebar layout + main canvas, full multi-column kanban board for 8 deal stages

components_and_features.auth_screen: Phone + OTP single consultant login experience (no user-type selection). Warm CRED-style dark/navy hero panel + crisp white card.
components_and_features.onboarding: Interactive 3-slide onboarding experience with smooth progress dots, feature callouts, and 'Get Started' action.
components_and_features.top_navbar: Sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 dark:bg-slate-900/85 z-40 border-b). Includes Brand Logo, Search Bar, Quick Add Button, Notification Bell with unread badge count, and Profile Avatar Menu (Profile, Notifications, Shared Properties, Bin, Settings, More, Logout).
components_and_features.kpi_cards: 4 clickable dashboard metrics cards with subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1): Total Properties, Active Customers, Open Follow-ups, Deal Value Pipeline in Indian Rupees (₹).
components_and_features.property_wizard: 4-step wizard (Category & Type → Property Details → Amenities & Features → Photo Upload & Review) with step indicator, Indian currency dual-range sliders (₹0 to ₹50 Crore), validation, and live preview.
components_and_features.property_cards: Rounded cards featuring high-quality primary photo, property status badge (Sale/Purchase/Rent/Lease), category (Residential/Commercial/Land), price formatted in Cr/Lakh (e.g. ₹2.5 Cr), location, and GREEN SHARED TICK INDICATOR if shared with consultants.
components_and_features.photo_lightbox: Swipeable photo modal/lightbox with gallery thumbnails, full-screen viewer, photo counter, and close control.
components_and_features.customer_module: Customer directory with requirement tags, budget range, preferred location, and Many-to-Many Property Linking drawer/modal.
components_and_features.follow_up_tracker: Follow-up list with status filters (Pending, Today, Overdue, Completed), priority badges, due date countdowns, and quick log action.
components_and_features.deal_pipeline: 8-stage Kanban board (Lead Identified → Requirement Analysis → Property Match → Site Visit Scheduled → Negotiation → Token/Advance → Documentation → Won/Lost) with drag/click stage advancement, deal value summaries, and win/loss reason modal.
components_and_features.consultant_sharing: Property sharing modal to collaborate with other brokers, green verified tick badge indicator on shared listings, and 'Shared Properties' dedicated view.
components_and_features.bin_and_recycle: Bin module displaying soft-deleted properties and customers with 1-click 'Restore' or 'Permanent Delete' functionality.
components_and_features.empty_states: Rich empty state components with custom illustration/icons, friendly micro-copy, and primary CTA buttons (e.g. 'No properties listed yet', 'No matching customers found').
components_and_features.loading_states: Pulse skeleton cards matching property and customer card shapes.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the design feels ultra-premium like CRED / Apple / Linear — smooth cards, crisp typography, generous padding, and responsive layout.
Indian Currency Formatting: Always format monetary values in ₹ Cr (Crores) or ₹ Lakhs (e.g., ₹2.5 Cr, ₹75 Lakh). Provide dual-range sliders for ₹0 to ₹50 Crore requirement filtering.
Green Shared Tick: Property cards and detail view MUST display a distinct green verified tick badge when shared consultant-to-consultant.
Do NOT use generic admin styling. Implement custom rounded cards (rounded-2xl) with subtle border lines (border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800) and elevated shadows.
Mobile Responsiveness: Mobile screens MUST render a fixed bottom navigation bar (Home, Properties, Customers, Deals, More) with clear icon active states.
Make sure all modals, slide-overs, lightboxes, and dropdown menus have semi-solid backdrop blur backgrounds (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90) with high contrast text.
All interactive components MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.
